scripts.trigger: aws lambda invoke --region us-east-1 --function-name bi-agent-daily-report --cli-read-timeout 180 --payload "{\"source\":\"manual\"}" --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out report-output.json && node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('report-output.json','utf8')"
scripts.reseed: aws lambda invoke --region us-east-1 --function-name bi-agent-seed-data --cli-read-timeout 180 --payload "{\"RequestType\":\"Update\"}" --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out seed-output.json && node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('seed-output.json','utf8')"
scripts.trigger:dry: aws lambda invoke --region us-east-1 --function-name bi-agent-daily-report --cli-read-timeout 180 --payload "{\"source\":\"manual\",\"dryRun\":true}" --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out report-output.json && node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('report-output.json','utf8')"
